verdict.rationale: As a JavaScript framework, Vue's product surface is its public programmatic API. The docs include a dedicated API reference section, with documented reference pages such as createRenderer() and the SSR streaming functions. That API is governed by a published semver and deprecation policy, and the docs are also offered in LLM-friendly form via /llms.txt. Missing for 10: direct evidence of the full core API reference contents (only the nav entry and specific sub-pages are shown), independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use, and any network/HTTP API (OpenAPI probes returned 404), though a library is not expected to have one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
